versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.2

- Removed unused data files: data/index.json and data/types.yaml.
- Updated internal storage logic in lib/store.js to remove reliance on the deleted files.
- No user-facing feature changes; all core workflows remain unchanged.
- Documentation (SKILL.md) updated for consistency, with no major content changes.

- Added a YAML frontmatter section with name and description to SKILL.md.
- Clarified description to emphasize local-first, YAML-based knowledge base with no cloud lock-in.
- No changes to skill logic; documentation only.

Initial release: introduces a guided object-based personal knowledge base.

- Onboards users step-by-step to define and use custom object types (ideas, projects, tasks, or custom).
- Provides interactive setup, including field customization and first object creation.
- Offers commands for adding, linking, listing, expanding, and editing objects.
- Stores data locally in YAML and JSON (no cloud dependencies).
- Supports extensible object types, inter-object linking, and customizable workflows.
